description: Microsoft and The Nature Conservancy publish mapped solar-farm geometries for India to support monitoring and land-use planning. The GitHub release provides raw polygons, merged farm geometries and simplified geometries as GeoJSON, with identifiers, area, centre coordinates and state labels. It names a 2021 snapshot and reports 1,363 validated farms, while the linked Zenodo description reports 1,438. The numerical difference was not reconciled by inspecting the payload. Access is free; the Zenodo archive states CC BY 4.0 and GitHub separately states CDLA-Permissive-2.0 for its data. Modellers can use the footprints to locate generation assets or intersect hazard and land-use layers, alongside data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that these mapped utility-scale installations are not a complete inventory of rooftop panels or measured generation. The two published counts and distribution licences should be kept with the specific version used. No geometries were downloaded or independently checked.
